name: Kuavo
summary: A full-size humanoid from Shenzhen's Leju Robotics, sold as a research and service platform and notable as an early robot to run on Huawei's HarmonyOS with Pangu AI integration. Later Kuavo models add modular walk/wheel mobility and interchangeable hands.
notable: Early humanoid on Huawei HarmonyOS + Pangu AI
Used in Chinese embodied-AI research and exhibitions
